verse.verse_1: The Last Hour draws near and the moon is split asunder.
verse.verse_2: Yet, when they see a sign they [who deny the truth] turn their backs and say, "The same old sorcery!"
verse.verse_3: They deny the truth and follow their own whims, every matter has its appointed time,
verse.verse_4: there has come to them many a tiding wherein there are warnings,
verse.verse_5: profound in wisdom, but all warnings have been of no avail:
verse.verse_6: so ignore them. On the Day when the Crier will call out about a horrible event,
verse.verse_7: with downcast eyes they shall come out of their graves, as if they were locusts milling about
verse.verse_8: hastening towards the Crier. Those who deny the truth will cry, "This is such a hard day!"
verse.verse_9: The people of Noah denied [the truth] before them. They belied Our messenger saying, "He is mad!" He was rebuffed,
verse.verse_10: so he cried out to his Lord, saying, "I am overcome, so help me!"
verse.verse_11: So We opened the gates of the sky with water pouring down in torrents,
verse.verse_12: and We caused the earth to burst with gushing springs: so that the waters met for a purpose which had been decreed.
verse.verse_13: We bore him on an [ark] which, made of planks and nails,
verse.verse_14: floated on under Our eyes: a vindication of him who had been rejected.
verse.verse_15: We have left this as a sign: but will anyone take heed?
verse.verse_16: How terrible then was My punishment and My warning.
verse.verse_17: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran. Is there anyone who would receive admonition?
verse.verse_18: The people of 'Ad too rejected the truth. How terrible was My punishment and My warning.
verse.verse_19: We sent a raging wind against them on a day of continuous calamity.
verse.verse_20: It swept people away as if they were trunks of uprooted palm trees.
verse.verse_21: How [dreadful] was My punishment and My warning!
verse.verse_22: We have made it easy to learn lessons from the Quran: is there anyone who would receive admonition?
verse.verse_23: The tribe of Thamud also rejected Our warnings:
verse.verse_24: they said, "Are we to follow a man from amongst ourselves? We would surely then fall into error and madness.
verse.verse_25: Has the [Divine] message been revealed to him alone of all of us? No, he is a boastful liar."
verse.verse_26: [We said to him] "Tomorrow they shall know who is the boastful liar,
verse.verse_27: for We are [going to] send the she-camel as a trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
verse.verse_28: And tell them that the water [of the well] is to be divided between them, and that each one should drink in turn."
verse.verse_29: But they called their companion who took a sword and hamstrung her.
verse.verse_30: How [terrible] were My punishment and My warnings!
verse.verse_31: Then We sent a single blast against them and they became like dry stubble which has been trampled upon.
verse.verse_32: Indeed, We have made the Quran easy to learn lessons from. Is there anyone who would receive admonition?
verse.verse_33: The people of Lot rejected Our warnings.
verse.verse_34: We sent a sandstorm against them which destroyed them all, except the family of Lot, whom We saved at the break of dawn,
verse.verse_35: as a blessing from Us: this is how We reward the thankful.
verse.verse_36: Lot warned them of Our punishment, but they disputed the warnings --
verse.verse_37: they even wanted to seduce his guests -- but We blinded them, and said, "Taste My punishment now that you have scorned My warnings!" --
verse.verse_38: and early in the morning the punishment decreed overtook them --
verse.verse_39: "Taste My punishment now that you have scorned My warnings!"
verse.verse_40: We have made it easy indeed to learn lessons from the Quran. Is there anyone who would receive admonition?
verse.verse_41: Surely warners came to the people of Pharaoh.
verse.verse_42: They, too, rejected all Our signs. So We seized them with the seizure of One Mighty, Omnipotent.
verse.verse_43: Are your people who deny the truth better than those? Or have you been given immunity in the Scriptures?
verse.verse_44: Or do they say, "We are a united group, and we are bound to prevail?"
verse.verse_45: The hosts shall soon be routed and they shall be put to flight.
verse.verse_46: Indeed, the Hour of Doom is their appointed time, and the Last Hour will be the most severe, and the most bitter.
verse.verse_47: The evil-doers are indeed sunk in error and folly --
verse.verse_48: on the Day when they are dragged into the fire on their faces, it will be said to them, "Now feel the touch of Hell!"
verse.verse_49: We have created everything in due measure;
verse.verse_50: We command but once: Our will is done in the twinkling of an eye;
verse.verse_51: We have indeed destroyed many a people like you. Is there anyone who would receive admonition?
verse.verse_52: All their deeds are recorded in their books:
verse.verse_53: every action, small or great, is noted down.
verse.verse_54: The God-conscious will find themselves in gardens and rivers,
verse.verse_55: in the seat of truth with an all-powerful sovereign.
